origin: A generateContent request of a Gemini client, authored from the documented shapes with placeholder ids (no capture, and not a copy of what any release of the Gemini CLI sends; its tool names, its generation settings with a dynamic thinking budget, the functionCall and functionResponse parts with the ids of the gateway), model gemini-2.5-pro: the relay fails and the native tier answers; the next request of the conversation goes to the native tier at once, as a session that was moved down stays there (the relay is not asked, and no relay is left out of the plan). The relay answers are authored from the documented Chat Completions shapes; the expected files are what the gateway does with them.
